acceptance: buildPrompt(specContent, { maxCauses }) asks for "at most <n> causes" when maxCauses is provided and "5 to 10 causes" by default, and always asks for the causes ranked most likely first.

premortem CLI accepts --max-causes <n>, validates that <n> is a positive integer >= 1 (exiting 1 via opError otherwise), and forwards maxCauses to run() and buildPrompt() including in --prompt-only mode.
title: premortem: add --max-causes <n> and rank causes most likely first (#1292)
